response.sql: WITH j AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS mktnote, (f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), overall AS (SELECT AVG(net) AS avg_net FROM j), pairs AS (SELECT mktnote, AVG(net) AS pair_avg FROM j GROUP BY mktnote) SELECT AVG(p.pair_avg) AS mean_pair_avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.pair_avg - ov.avg_net) AS mean_excess_over_overall FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall ov WHERE p.pair_avg > ov.avg_net;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average net fee rate is the average of (feerate - rebrate) over all matched fee records, not an average of the per-pair averages. A fee with a NULL feerate or rebrate has a NULL net rate and is skipped.

The result is the unweighted mean across the qualifying pairs of each pair's average net fee rate and of its excess over the overall average. Fees that lack a pair share one NULL group via GROUP BY. If no pair qualifies or the overall average is NULL, the single row contains NULLs.
